base = '''OMEGA context: oMEGA is a new central integration repo. for spec in PROVIDERS:

    models=split_values(os.getenv(spec.models_env)) or list(spec.default_models)

if not providers:

outdir=pathlib.Path('/workspace/omega_free_review_swarm'); outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
def one(i, role_task):

    spec,keys,models=providers[i % len(providers)]

    return {'i':i,'role':role,'provider':spec.name,'model':model,'status':status,'text':text[:2600]}

print('WORKERS',len(rows),'SUCCESS',sum(1 for r in rows if 200 <= r['status'] < 300))
for r in rows:
